name: pumi-agent-overview
description: Every agent in this pumi in one pane: who is working, who is blocked, and where.

poll_secs.label: Refresh every
poll_secs.desc: How often it reads the model again, besides the events it follows (an agent's state, a pane or tab opening or closing).

hide_idle.label: Hide idle agents
hide_idle.desc: Leave out agents that are only waiting for a prompt, except the pane you are in.

rail_width.label: Rail width
rail_width.desc: How wide the list of sessions and agents is.

key.label: Key
key.desc: A chord that opens the overview from anywhere (the root key table). Empty for none; `pumi call amresyd.agent_overview.open` works regardless.
